results.role: one row per deterministic path and simulation step

iteration_summary.role: per-step descriptive summary across repeated deterministic paths

metrics.label: Illustrative master token price
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Master price emitted by the configured PriceFunction_IssuanceCurve component with the allowlisted named curve log_power; not a market forecast.

metrics.label: Master circulating supply
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Master circulating supply: issuance-curve minting minus the dependent economy's fiat-denominated inflow drawn after each dependent execute (illustrative, uncalibrated).

metrics.label: Illustrative dependent token price
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Dependent price emitted by the configured PriceFunction_BondingCurve component with the allowlisted named curve quadratic; not a market forecast.

metrics.label: Dependent circulating supply
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Dependent circulating supply minted by the bonding curve from the exogenous synthetic dependent-demand series; no channel feeds this control.

metrics.label: Dependent fiat-denominated inflow
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Exogenous synthetic dependent-demand series (gentle linear ramp, recorded seed 20260824) replayed through TransactionManagement_FromData; the disconnected companion to the channeled inflow of the multi-token demo.

metrics.label: Master fiat transaction volume
metrics.aggregation: mean across repeated deterministic paths at each step
metrics.description: Documented linear master demand trend (120,000 to 480,000 illustrative $ per step) replayed by the Trend controller.

repeatability.explanation: For this reviewed scenario, matching config hash and seed produce matching canonical table-content hashes. Exact file hashes also include the unique run_id lineage field.

variability.explanation: All selected controllers are deterministic, so repeated paths are identical and do not provide statistical uncertainty evidence.

interpretation_boundary: This is an illustrative, uncalibrated scenario. It is not investment, launch, legal, financial, forecast, or decision-grade advice; live decisions require qualified review and external evidence.
